models.scope: MRV including BCC; 80 global workload classes; no regional/ALL_NIV double counting

formulas.B_applications: raw national B-class weight=issued/(1-adjusted national B refusal rate); normalize within each B1/B2/B1-B2 class to published worldwide applications; fallback to worldwide class ratio when unavailable/100%
formulas.calendar2025: FY2025_actual flat-time proxy; no FY2026 actual invented
formulas.nationality_sensitivity_2025: multiply one payer weight by0.75/1.25; denominator=1+(factor-1)*payer_share; renormalize all payers to account control

models.sensitivity_interpretation: Every coherent fee/bridge allocation scenario is normalized to the same control. 2025 timing scenarios change the account control by ±15%. Individual flow lower/upper envelopes include alternative models and separate nationality shocks, cannot be summed into a joint global range, and are not statistical confidence intervals.
limitations: Adjusted B refusal rates count unique applicants with last fiscal-year action and adjusted overcomes, not matched raw application or paid-fee events.
Global workload applications are published activity counts, not verified fee-payment events; fiscal timing and accounting timing can differ.
Fee-mixture/bridge weights allocate an observed MRV account; normalization does not prove each nationality paid that amount.
CY2024 assumes uniform within-fiscal-year receipts and stableFY2024 nationality/class shares.
CY2025 is a FY2025-total proxy with FY2024 allocation shares, not observed calendar2025 receipts or nationality issues.
Other specific waivers and refunds beyond A/G/NATO/C2/C3 and J/BCC mix are absorbed by account calibration; reciprocity, SEVIS and USCIS amounts are excluded.
No-issuance classes with published applications retain UNK_USA origin, and non-country nationality labels retain shared resolver RAW codes.
J exchange is grouped other rather than assumed student; all K dependants grouped family, work-dependent classes follow work family.

models.sensitivity: 所有费用科目共用w=0.15/0.25/0.35与互补1-w；取完整情景端点包络，不是统计置信区间。
models.scope: Six disjoint fiscal revenue accounts. Study/work include inland applications and extensions. Payers are applicants, not country governments.
models.accounting_basis: Reported fiscal revenue, not independently measured cash receipts in each calendar year.
models.trv_scope: Use the exact published Multiple entry account plus separate family maximum account. Single-entry revenue is not separately labelled; do not infer a missing residual or assume a separate zero.
models.reconciliation: Published Public Accounts Temporary Residence leaf accounts, including excluded eTA/IEC/etc, sum exactly to Fees Report programme revenue in FY2024-25 and FY2025-26. The programme is a check, not an extra flow.

models.description: 按V-1获批或新学签结案的来源国份额分配实际科目桥接金额；这不是付费申请人的实测国籍分布。
models.visitor_proxy: Calendar-year Visitor V-1 approved persons, including family-cap allocation; refusals are not estimated by country.
models.study_proxy: Calendar-year New study permit processed persons, applied to revenue including extensions; extension distribution may differ.
models.suppression: Published -- means 1–4; central 2.5, sensitivity 1–4. Published multiples of 5 vary ±2.5 in share sensitivity.
models.rounding: Normalize sum of country cells instead of forcing rounded published WORLD to equal the country sum.
models.unknown_origin: Work permit, group and open-work accounts remain entirely UNK because a matching payer-country distribution is absent.
models.range_scope: Individual country envelopes are marginal, not jointly additive. Country-share uncertainty redistributes a fixed destination amount.
